text: Just as one who is in the theater is called “the one in the theater,” so too, the spectator, being a single, pure Purusha, thinks, “I am seen by him.” Thereupon, Prakriti, which is one and the same, and which is the principal cause of the three worlds, ceases and withdraws. There is no second Prakriti. Even though the distinctions of form and species arise, and even though the separation of Prakriti and Purusha occurs, their union persists due to their all-pervasiveness. However, creation does not arise from this union.
